subject: Cloud procurement routing: Marketplace vs PO — next steps (Uplift Health)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Reddy <sana.reddy@uplifthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:00:00Z
Subject: Cloud procurement routing: Marketplace vs PO — next steps (Uplift Health)

Hi Sana — thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap from today's demo:
- Uplift Health wants a 6-week pilot for the Redwood hosted API (chat + embeddings) across a two-team pilot (Data Science + Product).
- Primary constraint is procurement: finance expects either a PO (Net 30) or a marketplace purchase via AWS preferred.
- Security asks: SOC 2 Type II evidence and an IP/data flow diagram (we shared NDA-friendly material during call).

Open / action items we discussed:
1) Procurement path preference: can you confirm whether you must go through a PO (vendor on AP vendor registry) or if a credit card/p-card pilot is possible for an initial 30-day trial?
2) Marketplace: you mentioned AWS Marketplace as preferred — can you confirm whether your procurement team requires a marketplace listing (metered/contract) vs. a standard PO invoice?
3) Procurement contact: please share the point person and expected timeline for PO processing (approx. days to vendor onboarding).
4) Technical check: do you need KMS integration or specific region isolation (e.g., us-east vs us-west)?

Proposed route from our side: 
- If a PO is required and timeline is 3+ weeks, we can provision a short pilot on card to validate integration and then transition to PO for production.
- If Marketplace is required, we can start the Marketplace intake in parallel — typical listing + pricing sync takes 2–4 weeks depending on legal/finance review.

Attachments: Uplift_Demo_notes.pdf (quick summary).

Can you confirm the procurement contact and whether a card pilot is feasible? If helpful, I can set a short 20-min sync between procurement + our commercial ops this week.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sana Reddy <sana.reddy@uplifthealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rick Belmont <rick.belmont@uplifthealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T18:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Cloud procurement routing: Marketplace vs PO — next steps (Uplift Health)

Thanks Vanessa — great demo and helpful recap. Quick answers below: 

1) Our default is to purchase via PO (Net 30). Finance policy requires vendors to be in our vendor registry. Typical onboarding is ~2–3 weeks once we have vendor paperwork and the quote.
2) AWS Marketplace is preferred for any recurring SaaS spend — that gives visibility to our procurement systems and simplifies cost allocation. We would prefer Marketplace if Redwood can support the listing. If Marketplace listing will cause delay, we can do a PO first and then migrate spend to marketplace.
3) Procurement lead: Rick Belmont (rick.belmont@uplifthealth.com). He handles vendor onboarding and PO issuance. Rick — I’m looping you in.
4) Security: we will need SOC 2 Type II and a simple diagram of data flow. No special KMS requirements for the pilot — standard region us-east-1 is fine.

I attached our procurement_requirements.xlsx that lists vendor form fields and contract routing steps. Happy to do a 15-min sync with your ops team — Rick, any availability Tuesday/Wednesday next week?

Best,
Sana Reddy
Head of Product Operations | Uplift Health
Sana.Reddy@uplifthealth.com

Attachments: procurement_requirements.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-09-16T09:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Cloud procurement routing: Marketplace vs PO — next steps (Uplift Health)

Vanessa — forwarding Sana's note and procurement sheet. Thoughts on recommended commercial path: 

- Recommended: offer a two-step flow: (A) 30-day pilot on corporate card to avoid losing momentum, (B) start Marketplace intake immediately in parallel so we can transition recurring spend to AWS Marketplace within 2–4 weeks.
- Why: PO-only path risks a 2–3 week hold. We can mitigate risk by agreeing to a pilot SOW/invoice that rolls into a Marketplace contract so their finance sees the transition plan.
- Internal ops asks: we should prepare a short vendor packet (vendor form + SOC 2 link + sample invoice) and a Marketplace onboarding checklist. I’ll pull the Marketplace ops owner for a quick intro if you want me to.

Action items for us: 
1) Vanessa: schedule 20-min sync with Rick + Sana — proposed slots Tue/Wed next week.
2) Marissa: can you prepare the vendor packet and a sample card-invoice option (line items, pilot pricing, and conversion terms) by EOD Monday?
3) I'll start the Marketplace intake request and share the onboarding timeline (ops).

Subject: Re: Cloud procurement routing: Marketplace vs PO — next steps (Uplift Health)

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Sana + Rick — good to have clarity. Proposed plan: 

1) Pilot approach: Uplift runs a 30-day pilot on a corporate card to get Data Science and Product teams integrated (we'll ship a one-page pilot SOW + invoice). After successful pilot we convert to a PO or marketplace subscription depending on finance preference.
2) Marketplace intake: Karthik will open the Marketplace onboarding request today. We expect initial listing & pricing sync in 2–4 weeks; if Marketplace hits a blocker we will accept PO invoicing as the fallback.
3) Procurement sync: Rick — can you do Tue 2026-09-21 at 11:00 AM ET for a 20-min call? If not, suggest a time and we’ll accommodate. Agenda: vendor packet review, PO timeline, and transition to Marketplace.

Action items we own: 
- Marissa: vendor packet + pilot invoice template (due EOD Mon 2026-09-20).
- Karthik: marketplace intake + ops owner intro (today).
- Vanessa: send DocuSign pilot SOW and calendar invite for 9/21 once Rick confirms.

Sana — attaching our Redwood marketplace onboarding cheatsheet for reference.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the sync.
